user.title: Connect to the AI Usage app
user.description: Usually Home Assistant finds the AI Usage app on its own. Enter its address and token here only if the app runs outside Home Assistant's app system.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the AI Usage app.

data_description.api_token: The token in the app's `/data/api_token` file.

reauth_confirm.description: The AI Usage app no longer accepts the token. Enter its current token.
